ios.NSLocationWhenInUseUsageDescription: VYRO uses your location to show your position on the map and measure distance during a workout.
ios.NSLocationAlwaysAndWhenInUseUsageDescrip: If you enable recording with the screen locked, VYRO uses your location during a workout you start, including when you lock the screen or use another app. GPS recording stops when you pause or finish.
ios.NSPhotoLibraryUsageDescription: Choose a photo to share in VYRO.
